summary: This table presents a comparison of quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) and year-over-year (YoY) growth percentages, with values reported in two categories: 'Reported' and 'CC'. The QoQ growth shows a decline with reported figures at -4.2% and CC at -3.5%. In contrast, the YoY growth indicates an increase, with reported figures at 3.6% and CC at 4.8%. This table highlights the differences in growth rates over different time periods and reporting methods.
